description: Add a gig date to a booking. date=YYYY-MM-DD required. Optional: type (event-type id), setup_time/start_time/end_time/done_time (HH:MM), participants, volunteers, venue, address, city, state, zip, phone, timezone, is_public, segment_price, act_id (this date's act — only with 'Book multiple acts per booking' on; else the booking's act).

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter code, e.g. MI.

type.description: A type value — see the tool's description for the allowed set.

name: add_date
title: Add Date
